package.name: ankle_kinematics
package.description:
Kinematic mapping for the parallel RSU ankle: foot pose (pitch, roll) to and from motor angles (theta_A, theta_B). Stateless, deterministic, pure numpy.
This is a LIBRARY, not a node. It has no ROS dependency -- the manifest exists so colcon builds it and ROS 2 packages can import it, which is what keeps consumers from copying the geometry constants instead. Every entry point takes an AnkleGeometry as its first argument, so the solver itself is robot-agnostic; LEFT_LEG / RIGHT_LEG are the URDF_5 instances.
